description: Sends a quote request to the studio for anything not bookable directly (weddings, baptisms, corporate photo/video, photobooth / 360 videobooth / AI caricature mirror, couple or proposal sessions, studio events, prints). Creates the request in the studio's system; the client gets a confirmation email and a personal proposal within 24 hours. Only call after the user confirms the details and agrees to be contacted.
